items.title: Amazon CloudWatch announces log routing and chained log parsers
items.blurb: Amazon CloudWatch now supports conditional log routing and chained parsers via pipelines, giving you more control over how log data is transformed and which CloudWatch log group it's sent to.

items.title: Everyone is doing Git on S3 wrong
items.blurb: Why Git is hard to put on object storage, where write-ahead logs fall short, and how Enroute reaches 7,600+ pushes per second on a single repository.

items.title: ARC Region switch adds four new capabilities
items.blurb: Amazon Application Recovery Controller (ARC) Region switch helps you orchestrate the failover of multi-Region applications to achieve a bounded recovery time during a Regional impairment.

items.title: AWS License Manager now supports license type conversions for Ubuntu Pro purchased through AWS Marketplace
items.blurb: AWS License Manager now supports in-place upgrades for EC2 Ubuntu LTS (Long Term Support) instances to Ubuntu Pro available on AWS Marketplace.

items.title: Amazon SageMaker Studio simplifies getting started for new AI/ML builders with social sign-in
items.blurb: Amazon SageMaker Studio now lets new customers sign up with their Google, GitHub, or Apple credentials and land inside a fully configured Studio environment - no traditional AWS account setup, no credit card, and no console navigation…

items.title: AWS HealthOmics introduces resource fallback order for Nextflow workflows
items.blurb: Today, AWS HealthOmics introduces the resource fallback directive for tasks in your Nextflow workflows, enabling you to define an ordered list of preferred accelerator types, including an option to fallback to CPU instances.

items.title: AWS Backup now supports Amazon FSx file systems in the Asia Pacific (New Zealand) Region
items.blurb: AWS Backup now supports Amazon FSx for Lustre, Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP, Amazon FSx for OpenZFS, and Amazon FSx for Windows File Server in the Asia Pacific (New Zealand) Region.
